scope: EDMD fixed dictionary, learned Koopman AE, augmented memory observer, EKF/UKF and nonlinear identification. Only these two new literature files edited.

undermind.operations: Metadata and abstracts only; no deep search, no PDF-reading agents, no manual PDF downloads, no remote files/folders created.
undermind.metadata_caution: Undermind returned preprint/conference years 2014/2017/1967 for EDMD/Lusch/Bryson; bibliography uses journal years 2015/2018/1968 verified from primary publisher/institution records.

sources.title: A Data-Driven Approximation of the Koopman Operator: Extending Dynamic Mode Decomposition
sources.verification: Author abstract plus institutional metadata; paper-search Crossref confirms DOI and journal year. No full PDF audited.
sources.supports: Snapshot pairs and dictionary of observables; classical EDMD is not an autoencoder.
sources.limits: Not a proof of closure or observability for selected ViT features; no learned encoder/decoder required by classical EDMD.

sources.title: Deep learning for universal linear embeddings of nonlinear dynamics
sources.verification: Publisher full HTML read: architecture, reconstruction/linearity/prediction losses, continuous-spectrum auxiliary network. Abstract also in Undermind.
sources.supports: Jointly learned encoder, decoder and latent dynamics; dynamical losses beyond reconstruction; parameterized latent operator in continuous-spectrum case.
sources.limits: Examples do not establish exact global fixed-matrix linearization for ViT/AdamW. Learned AE and fixed-dictionary EDMD remain distinct.

sources.title: Data-driven parameterization of the generalized Langevin equation
sources.verification: Author abstract and article indexed equations verified in preceding literature operation; no new PDF downloaded or full proof audited.
sources.supports: Rational memory-kernel approximation and extended stochastic state; specified equilibrium-statistics/FDT setting.
sources.limits: State-space approximation is a design hypothesis for AdamW; no automatic thermal equilibrium, FDT or whiteness.

sources.title: Estimation using sampled data containing sequentially correlated noise
sources.verification: NASA indexed author abstract and journal-year metadata; Undermind DOI and abstract. Publisher open failed, NASA direct open later returned 403. No PDF downloaded.
sources.supports: Filtering/prediction/smoothing with sequentially correlated measurement noise; augmentation can be ill-conditioned.
sources.limits: Not an unqualified endorsement of augmentation; measurement noise result cannot be automatically called GLE process memory.

sources.title: Unscented filtering and nonlinear estimation
sources.verification: Publisher search-indexed abstract and introduction; paper-search Crossref and Undermind confirm DOI/authors. Direct IEEE open restricted; abstract unavailable in Undermind. No full PDF audited.
sources.supports: EKF limitations from linearization; UT propagates means/covariances through nonlinear maps.
sources.limits: No exact universal nonlinear posterior or guarantee of stable long rollouts; use as candidate local approximation.

sources.title: Bayesian Filtering and Smoothing
sources.verification: Institutional book description, bibliographic DOI and publisher table of contents/chapter metadata; chapter summaries unavailable. Chapters and proofs not fully read.
sources.supports: Methodological reference covering nonlinear filtering, smoothing and parameter estimation.
sources.limits: No attribution of a specific unexamined theorem to this book. Causal filtering-versus-future-smoothing rule in synthesis is a protocol requirement.

sources.title: System identification of nonlinear state-space models
sources.verification: Publisher abstract, introduction and exposed conclusion checked; Undermind metadata confirms DOI, no abstract there. No full PDF audited.
sources.supports: ML/EM nonlinear state-space identification, particle smoothing for latent-state estimation, possibly non-Gaussian setting.
sources.limits: Training smoothing is distinct from causal forecast initialization; no future measurements allowed in the test filter.

project_inferences: Augment Koopman drift with identified finite memory state; check observation availability and conditioning rather than assuming observability.
H-step residual r_(tau,H) may be incorporated only once tau+H <= current time; correcting from an unfinished H-step label leaks the future.
Overlapping H-step errors can be autocorrelated even without physical GLE memory.
Marginal rollout propagates posterior state/memory and future input distribution conditional on past and known policy; actual future batches are oracle only.
Historical image features must be built with causally available extractor/checkpoint and jointly modelled dependencies.
Gaussian process need not be white; FDT is not automatic for AdamW.
